text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: Knight
source_text: Knight

text: I wonder what the old turbine engines were really like.
source_text: I wonder what the old turbine engines were really like.

text: Boy, I wish we had an automobile.
source_text: Boy, I wish we had an automobile.

text: Did you know that man has been on the moon? Or, at least, I think that's what they said.
source_text: Did you know that man has been on the moon? Or, at least, I think that's what they said.

text: Can you imagine what life would be like without technology? Well, I guess you've probably seen things pretty close to that.
source_text: Can you imagine what life would be like without technology? Well, I guess you've probably seen things pretty close to that.

text: I can't find the file I need.
source_text: I can't find the file I need.

text: I'll be a Paladin someday.
source_text: I'll be a Paladin someday.

text: Talus is a skilled warrior. I would never want to have to go up against him.
source_text: Talus is a skilled warrior. I would never want to have to go up against him.

text: Thomas is the best fighter in the Brotherhood. I bet he could kick Rhombus's butt.
source_text: Thomas is the best fighter in the Brotherhood. I bet he could kick Rhombus's butt.

text: I'd like to get my hands on those raiders. Show them what thieves deserve.
source_text: I'd like to get my hands on those raiders. Show them what thieves deserve.

text: That's it . . . what? Oh, sorry. I can't talk right now.
source_text: That's it . . . what? Oh, sorry. I can't talk right now.

text: I wonder what would happen if I . . . huh? Oh, you made me lose my train of thought.
source_text: I wonder what would happen if I . . . huh? Oh, you made me lose my train of thought.

text: 骑士
source_text: 骑士

text: 我一直在想以前的涡沦式引擎是什么样的。
source_text: 我一直在想以前的涡沦式引擎是什么样的。

text: 小伙子，我希望我们有一辆汽车。
source_text: 小伙子，我希望我们有一辆汽车。

text: 你知道那个男人已经登上月球了吗？或者……至少我认为他们是那么说的。
source_text: 你知道那个男人已经登上月球了吗？或者……至少我认为他们是那么说的。

text: 你能想象外面那些没有现代科技的生活吗？嗯，其实我们现在的生活也和那差不多了。

text: 我找不到我需要的文件。

text: 有一天我会成为一个游侠。
source_text: 有一天我会成为一个游侠。

text: 塔鲁斯是一个有经验的骑士，我从来没想过要升到他的上面去。
source_text: 塔鲁斯是一个有经验的骑士，我从来没想过要升到他的上面去。

text: 托马斯是钢铁兄弟会最出色的骑士。我敢打赌，他能一脚踢飞敌人的头。

text: 我想抓住那些袭击者，让他们后悔做强盗。

text: 那是它……什么？哦抱歉，我现在不能谈话。

text: 我想知道会发生什么事如果我……哦！？你打断我的思路了。
